name: Tangy carrot, cabbage & onion salad
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical side salad portion sizes for listed vegetable quantities (roughly 1/4 of total veg per serving).
Preparation time estimated from quick chopping, mixing, and dressing steps in instructions (no cooking involved).
Peanuts classified as allergen due to explicit roasted peanuts ingredient; tree nuts left null as no tree nuts are listed.
All other allergens marked false as confidently absent from listed ingredients.
instructions:
step 1
Tip the carrots, cabbage and onions into a bowl. Make the dressing by stirring the ingredients together until the sugar has dissolved. Pour over salad, tossing the vegetables in the dressing. Add the herbs, toss again, then scatter over the peanuts.

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.assumptions: 4 medium carrots, raw, edible portion only

ingredients.name: Red Cabbage
ingredients.assumptions: Half a medium head of red cabbage, raw, edible portion only

ingredients.name: Red Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 2 medium red onions, raw, sliced, edible portion only

ingredients.name: Mint
ingredients.assumptions: A typical handful of fresh mint leaves

ingredients.name: Coriander Leaves
ingredients.assumptions: A typical handful of fresh coriander (cilantro) leaves

ingredients.name: Roasted Peanut
ingredients.assumptions: A typical handful of roasted peanuts, about 30 g

ingredients.name: Lime
ingredients.assumptions: Juice of 2 limes, approx 100 ml, treated as 100 g of lime juice

ingredients.name: Red Chilli
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium red chilli, chopped, approx 30 g edible portion

ingredients.name: Brown Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tablespoon of brown sugar, approx 12 g
